summary: Changed note's $20-30 to fees $25 daily; cleared electric 30 (Pugliese states no amperage); season Apr 1-Oct 31; phone arrangement; dump. Second campground Sam Kerr flagged.
flags: SECOND CAMPGROUND: the same page lists Sam Kerr RV Campground ('water, electric (30 and 50 amp available), sewer, and trash'; daily $35, weekly $180, monthly $600 + KW, seasonal $1,800 + KW; 'Call park office at (740) 733-7941 to check for availability'). It isn't in this entry's fields because the entry is named for Pugliese. I could not locate it from the pages, Google Maps search or imagery, so I can't say whether it is a separate place under the split rule. A call would settle which RV cluster is which.
PIN: stored 40.2862,-80.7768 sits at a small RV cluster just north of the lakeside road. I can't confirm from the pages that this cluster is Pugliese rather than Sam Kerr.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview; no change proposed): the cluster's south edge is about 50 m from the lake with the road between, and a smaller pond lies about 40 m east. The rules mention night fishing 'along the lake on the road side'. Trees and the road may limit the view; this is an imagery read only.

PUBLIC NIGHTS: a daily rate is posted, so ordinary nights look open to the public. Seasonal rate exists but 'SEASONAL SITE IS NOT TO BE A PERMANENT RESIDENCE'. No length limit is posted; the rules let management refuse any RV 'not within the overall aesthetics of the park'.
